title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 25: the siege and fall of Jerusalem, the burning of the temple, Gedaliah's murder and Jehoiachin's release.

questions.text: What did Nebuchadnezzar's army build around Jerusalem when they encamped against it?
questions.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar and all his army encamped against Jerusalem and built forts against it around it.

questions.text: On the ninth day of the fourth month, what was there none of for the people of the land?
questions.explanation: The famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

questions.text: Where did the Chaldean army overtake the fleeing king?
questions.explanation: The Chaldean army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.

questions.text: To which place did they carry the captured king up to the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: They captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah, where they passed judgment on him.

questions.text: What did they do before Zedekiah's eyes?
questions.explanation: They killed Zedekiah's sons before his eyes, then put out his eyes, bound him in fetters and carried him to Babylon.

questions.text: Who came to Jerusalem in the fifth month and burned Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard came to Jerusalem and burned Yahweh's house, the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem.

answers.text: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard

questions.text: How high was one of the bronze pillars?
questions.explanation: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, with a bronze capital three cubits high on it.

questions.text: Whom did Nebuchadnezzar make governor over the people left in Judah?
questions.explanation: Over the people left in the land of Judah he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

questions.text: Who struck Gedaliah so that he died?
questions.explanation: In the seventh month Ishmael the son of Nethaniah came with ten men and struck Gedaliah, so that he died.

answers.text: Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard

questions.text: What did Evilmerodach king of Babylon do for Jehoiachin?
questions.explanation: Evilmerodach lifted up the head of Jehoiachin out of prison, spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the thrones of the other kings with him in Babylon.

answers.text: Sent him back to Jerusalem to reign as king
Made him governor over Judah at Mizpah
Put out his eyes and bound him in fetters
Lifted him out of prison and spoke kindly to him
